near.3: The dead stand across the barrows road in ranks, facing north. They look straight past you. They're waiting for someone else.
near.2: Fewer of the dead on the barrows road now. The ones left still face north, still waiting.
near.1: One rank left on the barrows road, close round an empty place where their standard stood. Still facing north.

thinned.2: Word from the barrows road: the front rank is gone. Where they stood there's only the road.
thinned.1: The bright-eyed ones are gone from the barrows road. The last rank stands closer together.
thinned.0: The barrows road is open. The last of the dead lay down where they stood, facing north. Col is already hitching his horse.
